name: Sussi la Cour
summary: Sussi la Cour, also known as Katja K or Katja Kean, is a Danish and international former pornographic actress, businesswoman, sitcom actress, singer, columnist, author, and media personality.

facts.value: Sussi La Cour studied experience leadership (Danish oplevelsesledelse) at Roskilde Universitetscenter (RUC) in Denmark.
